faq.subtitle: We answer your technical questions about our air conditioning and aerothermal installations so you can make the best decision for your home.
faq.q1: How much does it cost to install air conditioning in Reus?
faq.a1: The price of an air conditioning installation in Reus depends on the type of unit, the required power and the complexity of the installation. At Clima Reus HVAC Services we offer personalised quotes to ensure the best solution for your space and needs.
faq.q2: How often should air conditioning be serviced?
faq.a2: It is recommended to carry out maintenance at least once a year to ensure the proper functioning of the equipment. Maintenance helps improve energy efficiency, extend the life of the system and maintain good air quality.
faq.q3: In which areas do you offer air conditioning services?
faq.a3: We offer installation, maintenance and repair of air conditioning systems in Reus, Tarragona and nearby towns such as Cambrils, Salou and Vila-seca.
faq.q4: Do you repair all air conditioning brands?
faq.a4: Yes. Our technical service has experience in repairing different types of air conditioning systems and works with recognised brands such as Haier and Mitsubishi Electric, among others.

testimonials.title: What our clients say
testimonials.subtitle: At Clima Reus HVAC Services we take pride in a job well done. Over 4,000 installations carried out in Reus, Tarragona and surrounding areas are the best reflection of our commitment to quality, speed and professional service.

serviciosPage.title: Professional Air Conditioning Solutions
serviciosPage.subtitle: Installation, maintenance and repair with RITE-certified guarantee. Over 30 years creating the perfect climate for your home or business.
serviciosPage.s1title: Air conditioning installation in Reus and Tarragona
serviciosPage.s1desc: We carry out installation of split, multi-split and heat pump air conditioning systems tailored to the needs of each space. Our technical team manages the entire process: from the initial survey to commissioning.
serviciosPage.s2desc: Aerothermal is one of the most efficient solutions for heating homes and producing domestic hot water. We install modern systems that provide heating, cooling and hot water with a single unit.
serviciosPage.s3desc: Regular maintenance is essential to keep air conditioning equipment performing well and to prevent costly breakdowns. Our service includes a technical inspection, filter cleaning, refrigerant gas check and system verification.
serviciosPage.s4desc: If your air conditioning system is malfunctioning or not working properly, our technical team carries out quick diagnostics and professional repairs. We work with different types of HVAC systems and well-known brands.
